name: ABCCApp
fix_description: addFixedDay is public with no access control. Anyone can modify the fixedDay state variable which affects staking/reward time calculations. Add onlyOwner modifier.
difficulty_reasoning: The exploit is a short, direct chain: take a flash loan, call deposit, abuse addFixedDay to fast-forward state, claim DDDD, and swap to BUSD. It relies on an obvious protocol-specific logic flaw with only a few external calls and minimal cross-protocol complexity, so a competent auditor could likely reproduce it quickly.
